reader_question: Where did each 2024 presidential nominee’s joint fundraising committee send what it raised?
grade_line: Documented: the committees’ reports to the Federal Election Commission
title: Kamala D. Harris’s main joint fundraising committee sent $899.5 million to 55 committees in the 2024 cycle, and Donald J. Trump’s sent $273.8 million to two.
measure_line: Dollars each nominee’s joint fundraising committee paid to other committees, 2023 to 2024 election cycle; a link’s width is its dollars, on one scale for both
notes: Each nominee had more than one joint fundraising committee. Each drawn here is the one that sent the most to its nominee’s campaign, read the same way for both.
A joint fundraising committee raises money for several committees at once and splits it among them by agreement.
alt: Two committees, each a node with links running to the committees it paid. The Harris Victory Fund sent $528.7 million to the Harris campaign, $189.3 million to the Democratic National Committee, $181.4 million to 51 state party committees and $81,000 to two other committees. The Trump National Committee JFC sent $246.8 million to the Trump campaign and $26.9 million to the Republican National Committee.
